SIKAGROUT®-9800: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: SikaGrout®-9800, October 2025, Version 03.01 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/8/sikagrout-9800.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide SikaGrout®-9800 where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (October 2025, Version 03.01).
1.2 Product description. SikaGrout®-9800 is a shrinkage compensated, cement based grout which when mixed with water, produces a homogeneous, flowable and easy pump able grout with exceptional mechanical and physical properties. Latest best binder packing models and applied cementitious nanotechnology produces a grout with superior technical performance and exceptional rheological properties.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. SikaGrout®-9800 has been especially formulated for large scale, pump applications.
    - Grouting of grouted connections in offshore installations, e.g. foundations of wind turbines or oil & gas installations.
    - Typical applications are pile-sleeve and stab-in-pile grouted connections, clamp repair, leg filling etc…
    - Grouting under very harsh conditions, e.g. offshore applications or below water grouting, at temperatures as low as 2°C or up to 42°C.
    - All void filling from 30 mm to 600mm thickness where high strength is important.
    Contact the Technical Department of your local
    Sika office regarding any application required not mentioned here.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. SikaGrout®-9800
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: High strength grout with applied nanotechnology for grouting offshore wind turbine installations
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Certificates and test reports.
    - Certified by Det Norske Veritas (DNV)
    - DNV Type Approval Certificate no: TAK00000RW
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - EN206: cited elsewhere in the data sheet. Where: Features (p.1).
    - DIN1045: cited elsewhere in the data sheet. Where: Features (p.1).
    - EN 12390-3: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Compressive strength (p.2).
    - EN 206: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Compressive strength (p.2).
    - ASTM C469: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Modulus of elasticity in compression (p.2).
    - EN 12390-5: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Flexural-strength (p.2).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - C90/105 concrete strength class according EN206 and DIN1045
    - Can be installed with a continuous mixing and pumping process. Typical output rates of ≥ 20 m³/hour per mixing unit.
    - Quick return to service and removal of temporary supports due to high early strength build-up. ≥ 40 MPa @ 24hrs at 20°C.
    - Very good strength gain at low temperatures.
    - No segregation or bleeding to ensure consistent physical performance inside the grouted connection, and to prevent pump blockages.
    - Excellent fatigue resistance
    - No wash-out during below water grouting.
    - Pump able over long distances and large heights.
    - Specially graded sands and exceptional flow and low friction increases pump output, reduces installation times and costs as well as reducing pump pressures and wear.
    - Available as silo material.
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Density: Approximately 2.25 gr/cm3
2.6 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Bleeding: No bleeding; Sedimentation stability: No sedimentation; (in accordance of DAfStb Self compacting concrete, section N.1.2.)
2.7 Compressive strength.
    | N/mm² | 20 oC | 5 oC | 2 oC |
    | 3 days | ≥ 75 | ≥ 45 | ≥ 40 |
    | 7 days | ≥ 85 | ≥ 70 | ≥ 65 |
    | 28 days | ≥ 95 | ≥ 80 | ≥ 75 |
    | Resuts of 100 mm cubes |
    | Exposure classes: |
    | XO, XC4, XD3, XS2, XS3, XF3, XA2, WA |
    | Characteristic compressive strengths: |
    | Specimen size | 20 oC | 5 oC |
    | 100 mm cubes | Xk(n)≥ 90 N/mm² | Xk(n)≥ 80 N/mm² |
    | 150 x 300 mm cylinders | Xk(n)≥ 80 N/mm² |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)

2.8 Modulus of elasticity in compression.
    | Testing type | Result |
    | Static elasticity modulus | ≥ 30 GPa |
    | (150x300 mm cylinders) |
    | Dynamic elasticity modulus | ≥ 35 GPa |
    | (40x40x160 mm prisms) |
    | Poisson ratio: |

    Test method printed: (ASTM C469)
2.9 Flexural-strength.
    | Age | N/mm² |
    | 28 days | ≥ 10 |
    | Results of 700 x 150 x 150 mm bars |
    | Characteristic flexural strength: |
    | Xk(n) ≥ 9 N/mm² |
    | Results of 700 x 150 x 150 mm bars |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
    Test method printed: (EN 12390-5)
2.10 Shrinkage. Autogenous shrinkage: ≤ 0.4 mm/m; Tested according to Schleibinger shrinkage drain method; Test started 90 minutes after mixing – air sealed samples; Shrinkage class: SKVM 0; Tested according to DAfStb VeBMR Rili
2.11 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: SikaGrout®-9800 is supplied by bulk transport and is stored in special jobsite silos. Upon request, the material may be available as well in special 1000, 1250 kg kg big bags.
    - Shelf life: 6 months from date of production
    - Storage conditions: Product must be stored in closed silos or warehouse under dry conditions.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (October 2025, Version 03.01) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (October 2025, Version 03.01) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Mixing ratio: Approximately 145 lt / 1000 kg powder
    - Consumption: 1000 kg of powder will yield approximately 500 to 525 litre of mixed grout.
    - Layer thickness: 30 - 600 mm
    - Pot Life: ≥ 120 minutes
    - Setting time: ≤ 10 hours
4.3 Notes on installation.
    - Sands or other products that could affect the products properties must not be added.
    - SikaGrout®-9800 which will be exposed to strong drying conditions, e.g. mortar which is directly exposed to heavy wind and/or direct sunlight, should be protected using appropriate curing agents.
4.4 Equipment.
    | (other mixer types need approval from Sika) Operating limitations: | Mixer type | Jet mixer (Continuous mixing) |
    | Minimum diameter of grout lines | ≥ 2 inch |
    | Grout annulus | 30 ≤ t ≤ 600 |
    | Pumping length through 2” flexible hose | L ≤ 200 m |
    | Pumping elevated head with 2” flexible hose | H ≤ 20 m |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
4.5 Cleaning of equipment. Tools and spillages can be cleaned with water while SikaGrout®-9800 is still uncured. Once hardened, the material can only be removed mechanically.
4.6 Further documentation. Sika Method Statement: SikaGrout®-9800

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Material temperature. +2 °C min. / +42 °C max.
5.3 Ambient air temperature. +2 °C min. / +42 °C max.
5.4 Substrate temperature. +2 °C min. / +42 °C max.
5.5 Test methods printed beside stated values. Each value is as printed in the data sheet with its test method.
    - Compressive strength: N/mm² | 20 oC | 5 oC | 2 oC; 3 days | ≥ 75 | ≥ 45 | ≥ 40; 7 days | ≥ 85 | ≥ 70 | ≥ 65; 28 days | ≥ 95 | ≥ 80 | ≥ 75; Resuts of 100 mm cubes; Exposure classes:; XO, XC4, XD3, XS2, XS3, XF3, XA2, WA; Characteristic compressive strengths:; Specimen size | 20 oC | 5 oC; 100 mm cubes | Xk(n)≥ 90 N/mm² | Xk(n)≥ 80 N/mm²; 150 x 300 mm cylinders | Xk(n)≥ 80 N/mm² (EN 12390-3) (EN 206)
    - Modulus of elasticity in compression: Testing type | Result; Static elasticity modulus | ≥ 30 GPa; (150x300 mm cylinders); Dynamic elasticity modulus | ≥ 35 GPa; (40x40x160 mm prisms); Poisson ratio:; 0.271 (ASTM C469)
    - Flexural-strength: Age | N/mm²; 28 days | ≥ 10; Results of 700 x 150 x 150 mm bars; Characteristic flexural strength:; Xk(n) ≥ 9 N/mm²; Results of 700 x 150 x 150 mm bars (EN 12390-5)
5.6 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.7 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: SikaGrout®-9800, October 2025, Version 03.01, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/8/sikagrout-9800.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
